name: Verath & Lund Structured Ponte Blazer
description: A single-button blazer in deep navy ponte fabric with subtle ribbing visible only at close range, cut for a slightly relaxed shoulder — accommodating both chrome arm sockets and a broader range of body types than most Tier 3 options. Interior pocket is BCI-port lined, allowing passive device charging. The label is discreet; the quality speaks quietly.
functionality: BCI interior pocket with passive charging strip, aug-compatible shoulder seam, unstructured shoulder pad.
what_it_says: You've outgrown your current tier and you're dressing slightly ahead of it to prove the point.
story_hooks: The BCI charging pocket was installed by a third-party modifier — the original Verath & Lund design doesn't have one, and someone paid to have it retrofitted.
A manager wore this blazer to every performance review for six years; it's now associated in her team's minds with bad news.

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined, understated blazer with a modern relaxed silhouette. The deep navy reads as sophisticated without ostentation. Sits with gentle authority on the shoulders, avoiding the aggressive tapers of corpo wear while maintaining structure. The single-button closure creates a clean, uncluttered front panel.
physical_description.fit: Slightly relaxed through the shoulder and chest, with enough room to accommodate cybernetic augmentation without bunching. Tapers subtly at the waist. Sleeves have a gentle drop that works for both standard and augmented limbs. Not tailored-tight, but far from oversized — calibrated for working professionals.
physical_description.primary_material: Premium ponte knit fabric — a stable poly-blend composite that holds its shape while offering slight give. Treated for mild stain resistance and temperature regulation.
physical_description.texture: Smooth surface with barely-visible ribbing at close inspection, particularly along the upper back and sleeves. The weave has a soft sheen without gloss — catches light subtly.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep navy with charcoal undertones. Entirely monochromatic; the design relies on cut and material quality rather than contrast.
physical_description.closures: Single mother-of-pearl or composite button at chest. Friction-fit sleeve cuffs. Clean, minimal hardware.
distinctive_features: BCI-port lined interior pocket — allows inductive charging of neural interface devices
Chrome-compatible shoulder architecture — internally reinforced to accommodate augmentation weight distribution
Discreet woven label inside neck — Verath & Lund mark only, no flashy branding
Slight asymmetrical hem wear pattern typical of Tier 3 professional use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 crossover. High-quality workmanship and material costs suggest affluent working class or lower-tier corpo. The lack of status signaling reads as confidence rather than poverty.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented professionals, biotech sector employees, mid-level corpo managers, and augmentation technicians who need both credibility and practical functionality. Signals competence and accessibility — you're important but not untouchable.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or gently broken-in. Verath & Lund quality means it ages slowly. Minor thread wear at cuffs after 18+ months of use is expected and accepted.
